markdown_report:
Select a provenance-backed mutation audit before changing BERT4Rec training. At 10% progress, verifying the actual consumed-batch and loss paths provides a feasible foundation; exported-predictor parity remains a separate priority.

**Insights from the starting point**

- Electronics has 21.97% negative-outranking on audited training targets. This motivates investigation but establishes neither weak validation HR@10 nor its cause.
- Audited supervised positions contain MASK, yet event provenance remains unavailable. Mask presence cannot certify alignment or exclude target-event exposure.
- Live checks leave exported-predictor parity unknown. Training-prefix recovery cannot establish held-out usefulness or explain qualitative skips.

**Insights from related work**

- BERT4Rec [1,4] requires aligned masked-item supervision and appended-mask prediction. Trace event indices and actual loss contributions; repeated IDs alone cannot establish leakage.
- Metamorphic testing [2] motivates execution-relation checks. Transformer-specific relations require independently verified clean controls.
- Mutation testing [3,6] requires verified, applicable corruptions. Report invalid, equivalent and unresolved cases separately; missed detection does not prove equivalence.
- PyTorch loading [5] separates prefetched production from consumption. Capture tensors immediately before model use, transporting provenance with each batch without extra iteration or sampling.

These insights define three directions: supervision provenance, deployed-predictor consistency, and diagnostic sensitivity calibration.

| Direction | Existing evidence | Missing evidence | Proposed check |
|---|---|---|---|
| Supervision | MASK-position counts | Consumed-event alignment and loss | Batch capture, independent replay and loss recomputation |
| Deployment | Live score agreement | Saved predictor agreement | Reload identical fixtures |
| Calibration | Structural controls | Verified fault coverage and false alarms | Isolated mutant matrix with clean controls |

Three atomic ideas follow. Scores are originality/potential/difficulty; higher difficulty means harder implementation.

| Idea | Scores | Originality: positive / negative | Potential: positive / negative | Difficulty: favorable / challenging |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Consumed-batch provenance replay [1,4,5] | 4/7/6 | Connects event and loss evidence / established auditing | Resolves consequential uncertainty / no demonstrated ranking gain | No backbone change / worker transport and independent oracle |
| Exported-predictor parity fixtures [1,2] | 3/8/5 | Connects export to diagnostics / standard testing | Detects deployment defects / finite fixture coverage | Reuses scores / requires reload runner |
| Verified mutant matrix [2,3,6] | 4/7/6 | Family-specific calibration / established technique | Exposes ineffective assertions / artificial fault distribution | Isolated mutations / applicability and adjudication work |

Choose **consumed-batch provenance replay**, strengthening the original sampler audit. Carry source indices, crop bounds, targets and corruption decisions alongside production batches; capture detached CPU tensor clones in the main training loop immediately before forward execution. Replay only bounded consumed records, preserving the diagnostic interface and original training order.

Independently reconstruct inputs from public histories, verify same-event Cloze labels and strictly earlier terminal context, then recompute the actual weighted loss. Ignored positions must contribute zero direct loss. Calibrate assertions using verified shifted-label and restored-target faults plus independently checked clean and harmless controls; report detection denominators and false positives.

Return measured counts, failures and unavailable reasons. Preserve RNG states without claiming worker-state restoration or exact restart. Synthetic controls cannot certify unexercised paths. Keep one checkpoint per category and select subsequent revisions only through pinned four-category macro validation HR@10. No ranking gain, causal preference inference or correction of qualitative relevance failures is claimed.

idea.description: Instrument the actual corrected BERT4Rec production path with bounded event-level provenance, capture exact consumed batches immediately before model use, and independently replay their construction and loss against supplied training histories. Calibrate assertions with verified isolated faults and independently checked controls while retaining exactly one independently trained network per category.
idea.motivation: Current diagnostics observe reserved masks but cannot certify source events, corruption decisions, target alignment or the loss actually optimized. Resolving these uncertainties is actionable at 10% progress, while remaining distinct from exported-predictor parity, convergence and held-out recommendation usefulness.
idea.implementation_notes:
This is a proposed integration, not executable replacement training code: the actual sampler, training loop and loss implementation are not supplied. Preserve the existing report's three directions and treat exported-predictor parity as the next independent audit, rather than claiming provenance replay resolves it.

Add an optional provenance transport path to the actual production sampler/collator. Record category, user ID, source-event indices, branch, crop bounds, original selected labels, corruption decisions, supervised output positions, effective loss weights and existing negative-sampling decisions where applicable. Preserve source-event identities through cropping, padding and corruption. Transport records with their corresponding batch through an internal wrapper that the main loop unwraps; the model and diagnostic loader must still receive (None, sequence, positive, negative), with B×L tensors. Do not rely on worker-local dataset attributes becoming visible in the parent or on prefetched production logs identifying consumed batches. Missing provenance transport must return null with a reason; do not fabricate records from corrupted tensors.

In the main training loop, after all stochastic transformations and immediately before the forward call, capture detached CPU clones of the exact tensors and their associated provenance. Record category, epoch, batch index, forward step and optimizer-update outcome, including skipped updates when applicable. Fix a bounded capture schedule before execution, such as the first two consumed batches of the first completed epoch and the first two of the final executed epoch, retaining at most four records/category. If the final epoch is not known beforehand, replace the latest-epoch diagnostic buffer rather than advancing the loader. Label records as bounded subsets of consumed batches; they are not an exhaustive certificate and need not represent the deployed checkpoint's own training step. Capture consumes no RNG draws, creates no extra iterator and changes no generator wiring, worker persistence, ordering or sampling settings. Record capture overhead because execution consumes the shared budget.

Provide a replay iterable over captured tensor clones to DiagnosisProbe(view, device).run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), with corresponding trace access through an optional explicit side channel. Preserve all existing ModelView interfaces: view.model is the actual nn.Module; item_emb, log2feats(sequence), predict_score(features, items), user_train, meta_data and review_data remain compatible. Preserve diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis). Run model-dependent probes in evaluation/inference mode and restore every module's prior mode and main-process Python, NumPy, CPU and CUDA RNG states in finally. Replay must not advance a production loader. Main-process state restoration does not restore worker-local RNG, loader progress or persistent-worker state; exact training restart is outside this audit.

Use an independently implemented reconstruction checker grounded in supplied public training histories, rather than calling the producer's construction helper. Validate trace indices, crop boundaries, padding, catalog IDs and the declared effective corruption policy against exact captured tensors. Cloze labels must equal the original item at their corresponding source event. Surrounding historical context is legitimate for Cloze training; terminal targets require strictly earlier retained context and exclusion of target and later events by event index. Earlier occurrences of the same item remain legitimate. Verify the traced target event is not exposed through shifted supervision elsewhere in bidirectional input. The supplied corrected task uses reserved-mask supervision; record and check that effective policy rather than substituting BERT's generic 80/10/10 convention. Trace assertions establish consistency with recorded public histories, not cryptographic authenticity or complete pipeline correctness.

Trace supervision through the actual loss call. Capture detached logits or the exact scorer outputs already produced by the training forward, labels, selected indices, weights, negative IDs and reduction metadata for the bounded records. Independently recompute the declared loss from those same forward outputs without another stochastic forward pass. This checks loss wiring and reduction, not gradients through the entire network. For a sampled loss, retain its actual proposal, exclusions, accidental-hit handling and negative reduction; do not replace it with full-catalog cross-entropy. Require scalar loss agreement using predeclared tolerances appropriate to the recorded dtype, and report absolute/relative discrepancies and valid counts. Check ignored positions have zero direct contribution to the supervised loss; they may still influence supervised positions through attention or receive gradients from regularization. Record auxiliary and regularization terms separately. If the required outputs or loss specification are unavailable, report the check unavailable rather than inferring correctness from margins. A replay under the final evaluation checkpoint does not reproduce the historical training loss; same-forward capture is required for that assertion.

Calibrate detectors on copied records only; never train or select checkpoints using mutants. Predefine operator applicability. A shifted-label fault must produce a verified changed alignment or loss-relevant target; repeated IDs can make some shifts behaviorally equivalent. A restored-target fault applies only to a genuinely masked supervised target under the effective policy. Record original/changed values, intended violated property and independently verified injection success outside the detector. Include unchanged clean records only after independently checking their validity, plus harmless transformations with explicit preconditions, such as a bijective batch-row permutation applied consistently to tensors and provenance. Restoration checks must reproduce original records exactly. Do not treat detector disagreement or model scores as a correctness oracle.

For each operator, report attempted, inapplicable, invalid, proven-equivalent, unresolved, verified-corruption, detected and surviving counts with reasons. Define detection coverage as detected verified corruptions divided by applicable, valid, verified non-equivalent injected corruptions; return null for zero denominator. Unresolved cases remain separately visible and cannot be silently classified as equivalent. Report false-positive rate on independently verified clean/harmless controls separately, with operator-specific denominators. These are bounded fixture summaries, not estimates of real-world fault prevalence. Do not tune assertions to the same calibration cases without logging that adaptation; reserve predefined edge-case fixtures for a final detector check where feasible. Cover empty, short, full-length, unequal-left-padding and repeated-item cases, and report unsupported cases.

Return metrics, metric_definitions, assertion-specific denominators, failures, unavailable reasons, capture schedule and provenance artifacts beneath the current trial directory. Include measured evidence and definitions in the interpretation prompt, distinguishing consumed-batch evidence, synthetic controls, training-exposed recovery, deployment parity and host validation. Repeated item-ID equality alone must never be presented as proof of leakage. Preserve existing family-safe margin and embedding diagnostics, marking item categories, review content, ratings, commercial attributes and simulator traits unavailable. Qualitative feedback can motivate later hypotheses but cannot supply observed compatibility, ownership or demand labels.

Keep left padding, greatest-nonpadding-position readout, reserved-mask appended inference, all four category routes, DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], trial-local artifacts, preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, single-GPU execution, at most 200 epochs and exactly 200 batches per completed epoch. Preserve full-catalog unseen-item recommendations for the twenty designated real training users, five/category. No model architecture or scoring change is required; checkpoint configuration and embedded predictor writer must remain consistent. Fresh-process predictor parity remains unavailable unless a supported reload runner actually exercises the deployed writer, item mapping, routing and checkpoint. Deploy one selected checkpoint/category without averaging, additional fitted scorers or score fusion. Do not read other trials or reuse their checkpoints.

All host execution, diagnostics, debugging and failures consume the shared 43,200 GPU-second budget. Only pinned host four-category macro validation HR@10 selects model revisions; audit scores do not replace it. Bound and log adaptive diagnostic/validation queries. Report optimization effort separately: integrity does not establish convergence, and convergence or validation accuracy does not establish supervision integrity. The audit introduces no learned shortcut itself, but existing popularity or exposure shortcuts can remain even if every assertion passes. No held-out gain is claimed.
idea.pseudocode:
during_actual_production_sampling():
    batch, trace = record_existing_construction_decisions_without_extra_rng()
    transport_batch_and_trace_together_through_existing_worker_path()

for category in fixed_four_categories:
    for epoch in existing_training_schedule(max_epochs=200):
        for batch_index in range(200):
            batch, trace = unwrap_next_existing_production_batch()
            # All masking and sampling have already happened.
            capture = bounded_predeclared_capture_schedule(epoch, batch_index)
            if capture:
                record = detached_cpu_clones(batch, trace)
                record.step = current_forward_and_optimizer_step()
            outputs = actual_model_forward(batch)
            loss, loss_metadata = actual_declared_loss(outputs, batch)
            if capture:
                record.loss_inputs = detach_exact_same_forward_loss_inputs(
                    outputs, loss_metadata, batch)
                record.actual_loss = detach(loss)
            perform_existing_optimizer_update(loss)
            if capture:
                record.update_outcome = actual_update_outcome()
                retain_bounded_trial_local_record(record)

class DiagnosisProbe:
    def run_full_diagnosis(self, train_loader):
        state = capture_module_modes_and_main_process_rng()
        try:
            view.model.eval()
            with inference_mode():
                # train_loader here replays captured tensors; no production iteration.
                metrics, definitions = existing_family_safe_diagnostics(train_loader)
                records = explicit_optional_consumed_record_side_channel()
                if records is unavailable:
                    record_null_with_reason('sampler_provenance')
                else:
                    for record in records:
                        expected = independently_reconstruct_from_public_histories(record.trace)
                        check_indices_crops_padding_ids_and_exact_tensors(expected, record)
                        check_same_event_cloze_labels_and_effective_corruption_policy(record)
                        if record.trace.branch == 'terminal':
                            check_context_event_indices_strictly_precede_target(record)
                        check_no_shifted_target_event_exposure(record)
                        if exact_same_forward_loss_inputs_are_available(record):
                            expected_loss = independently_recompute_declared_loss(record)
                            check_loss_agreement_with_declared_dtype_tolerances(expected_loss, record)
                            check_ignored_positions_have_zero_direct_supervised_loss(record)
                        else:
                            record_null_with_reason('actual_loss_wiring')
                        accumulate_assertion_counts_failures_and_availability()
                    for record in predefined_calibration_subset(records):
                        clean_status = independently_verify_control(record)
                        record_clean_control_results_only_when_valid(clean_status)
                        for operator in ['shift_label_index', 'restore_masked_target']:
                            applicability = verify_operator_preconditions(record, operator)
                            if not applicability:
                                record_inapplicable_case(operator)
                                continue
                            mutant, injection_evidence = mutate_copy(record, operator)
                            status = independently_verify_changed_property_and_validity(
                                record, mutant, injection_evidence)
                            classify_invalid_equivalent_unresolved_or_verified_corruption(status)
                            if status == 'verified_non_equivalent_corruption':
                                record_detector_result_by_assertion(mutant, operator)
                        test_predeclared_verified_harmless_controls(record)
                    summarize_verified_corruption_detection_and_clean_false_positive_rates()
                return {'metrics': metrics, 'metric_definitions': definitions}
        finally:
            restore_module_modes_and_main_process_rng(state)

# Exact loader restart and worker-state restoration are not claimed.
# Check deployed predictor separately only when a supported reload runner exists.

def diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis):
    return prompt_with_measured_metrics_definitions_counts_and_reasons(
        raw_diagnosis,
        distinguish=['consumed_pipeline_evidence', 'synthetic_controls',
                     'training_recovery', 'deployment_parity', 'host_validation'],
        require=['fault_applicability', 'verified_injections', 'excluded_case_counts',
                 'clean_control_false_positives', 'unavailable_reasons'],
        prohibit=['invented_validation_gains', 'causal_preference_claims',
                  'equivalence_from_survival', 'ensemble_proposals'],
        require_single_model_BERT4Rec_revisions=True)

originality.positive: Connects consumed-batch capture, event-index reconstruction, actual loss verification and fault calibration within the fixed BERT4Rec diagnostic contract.
originality.negative: Tracing, independent replay, loss checks and mutation testing are established techniques; the contribution is a careful task-specific integration.

future_potential.positive: Provides actionable evidence for controlled sampler and loss experiments while separating production integrity, deployment consistency and ranking quality.
future_potential.negative: Finite captures cannot certify all execution paths, and passing integrity checks neither improves ranking directly nor resolves the qualitative usefulness failures.

code_difficulty.positive: Requires no new network or inference scorer, and bounded replay limits diagnostic computation.
code_difficulty.negative: Worker-safe provenance transport, exact consumed-batch association, same-forward loss capture, independent reconstruction and verified mutant accounting require substantial integration beyond localized sampler logging.

related_work.title: [1] BERT4Rec replicability study
contributions: Provides implementation and reproducibility context for BERT4Rec's masked-item training and appended-mask prediction.
Reports substantial convergence differences, motivating separate accounting of optimization effort and supervision correctness.
limitations: Does not certify the supplied sampler, trained checkpoint or exported predictor.
Terminal masking is established and should not be presented as a novel contribution.
Longer convergence in the study does not authorize exceeding this task's epoch or compute ceilings.

related_work.title: [2] Recommender metamorphic-testing study (2024)
contributions: Evaluates six metamorphic relations across LibRec, PREA and Surprise, motivating execution-relation checks.
limitations: Its reported scope does not directly validate BERT4Rec masking, padding, event-provenance or loss assertions.
A proposed harmless transformation requires explicit preconditions and independent verification.

related_work.title: [3] Mutation-testing study on optimisation software (2025)
contributions: Motivates assessing test relations against deliberately faulty implementations and reporting detection sensitivity.
limitations: Transfer to sequential recommendation is proposed rather than demonstrated.
Detection of selected artificial faults does not establish comprehensive pipeline correctness.

related_work.title: [4] BERT4Rec: Sequential Recommendation with Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformer
contributions: Defines aligned Cloze supervision with bidirectional context and appended-mask next-item inference.
Explains the leakage risk of shifted next-item targets under bidirectional attention.

The reference generator and loss implementation provide concrete corruption and prediction-weight semantics: https://github.com/FeiSun/BERT4Rec/blob/master/gen_data_fin.py and https://github.com/FeiSun/BERT4Rec/blob/master/run.py.
limitations: Reference defaults do not establish the supplied baseline's effective sampling or loss policy.
Repeated item IDs require event-index reasoning; ID equality alone cannot establish target-event exposure.
Correct reference semantics do not certify a separate exported predictor.

related_work.title: [5] PyTorch data-loading documentation and implementation
contributions: Documents main-process sampling, worker fetching and collation, worker seeds, generators, prefetching and persistent workers.
The DataLoader implementation clarifies why produced batches and consumed batches must be distinguished: https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/main/torch/utils/data/dataloader.py.
Supports capturing exact tensors in the main training loop without extra diagnostic iterator creation.
limitations: These sources explain mechanics rather than validating this proposed audit.
Documentation on the main branch may differ from the installed PyTorch version; record the actual version and loader settings.
Capturing consumed inputs does not provide exact restart of stochastic worker state.

related_work.title: [6] DeepMutation: Mutation Testing of Deep Learning Systems
contributions: Establishes training-data and training-program mutations as useful fault-injection categories.
Motivates testing detectors using explicit corruption operators.
limitations: The proposed consumed-batch detection denominator and independent injection verification are a task-specific synthesis.
Mutation operators require applicability checks; surviving mutants cannot automatically be classified as equivalent.

related_work.title: Stryker mutant states and metrics
contributions: Distinguishes mutant states and excludes invalid mutants from relevant mutation-score accounting.
Supports explicit denominator definitions and separate excluded-case counts.
limitations: Stryker's software-testing states do not directly define a standardized BERT4Rec data-pipeline metric.
Behavioral equivalence and unresolved cases require separate evidence.

related_work.title: Equivalent-mutant research
contributions: Motivates distinguishing behavior-preserving mutations from meaningful detector challenges.
limitations: Failure to detect a mutation is insufficient evidence of equivalence.
Equivalence of repeated-ID shifts can depend on the actual loss inputs and provenance property being tested.

related_work.title: TorchData StatefulDataLoader documentation
contributions: Documents loader checkpointing and aggregation of worker state with custom dataset and sampler hooks.
Clarifies why main-process RNG capture or a sampler cursor alone is insufficient for exact stochastic-worker restart.
limitations: Exact restart is separate from this bounded consumed-batch audit.
TorchData is not in the supplied library list; this proposal does not add it or change the production loader.

related_work.title: Pervasive Label Errors in Test Sets Destabilize Machine Learning Benchmarks
contributions: Supports independently verifying suspected errors rather than using detector outputs as ground truth.
limitations: Benchmark-label adjudication does not directly validate sequential-model provenance checks.
This task uses public-history reconstruction for structural assertions and does not inspect hidden test labels.
